Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing tax deductions for nonprofit convention and tourism promotion corporations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation taxation of paymentsand contributions to nonprofit convention and tourism promotioncorporations by public entities; and adding a new section to chapter82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taxamounts received by a nonprofit corporation organized under chapter24.03 RCW as payments or contributions from the state or any county,city, town, municipal corporation, quasimunicipal corporation, portdistrict, or public corporation for the promotion of conventions andtourism.
